name: Taragaman the Hungerer
summary: Beneath Orgrimmar, Taragaman the Hungerer prowls the molten caverns of Ragefire Chasm. The Horde seeks to destroy the hulking felguard, feared as the demonic master behind the Searing Blade cult, and end the demonic taint beneath the city.

sections.title: The Beast Below
sections.body: Taragaman the Hungerer prowls among Ragefire Chasm's magma pools, threatening Orgrimmar below. Scouts and young warriors sent into the dark caverns see the demonic felguard as the Searing Blade cult's leader. With infernal strength, he bends the weak-willed and corrupts the passages beneath Thrall's fortress.

sections.title: Lethal Decoy
sections.body: Taragaman the Hungerer commands the cult's fear, but its true leaders are the satyr Bazzalan and the warlock Jergosh the Invoker. The schemers use the towering felguard as expendable bait, a monstrous distraction that draws Horde defenders into the searing volcanic depths, where they can be slaughtered.

faq.q: What kind of demon is Taragaman the Hungerer?
faq.answer: Taragaman is a felguard, a brutal demonic shock trooper of the Burning Legion. He uses heavy melee strikes and fiery magic against intruders in Ragefire Chasm's magma caverns.

faq.q: Is Taragaman the Hungerer the leader of the Searing Blade cult?
faq.answer: Taragaman is widely believed to lead the Searing Blade. He is the most fearsome demonic power in Ragefire Chasm, and young Horde defenders are sent to slay him as the cult's master. The chasm may hold more secrets than a single felguard.

faq.q: Why does the Horde want Taragaman dead?
faq.answer: The Horde wants Taragaman dead because an active demonic presence festers beneath its capital. His infernal corruption threatens Orgrimmar from within, and killing him is vital to securing the cavern passages beneath the streets.
Taragaman resides deep within Ragefire Chasm, in subterranean volcanic tunnels reached from the Cleft of Shadow inside Orgrimmar.
Victorious adventurers carve out Taragaman the Hungerer's Heart as proof of the beast's death and to complete the work of clearing the demonic vanguard beneath Orgrimmar.

faq.q: How does Taragaman fight in combat?
faq.answer: Taragaman attacks with crushing physical blows, a powerful uppercut that sends foes through the air, and occasional bursts of Fire Nova that scorch those nearby.

angles.text: For young Horde warriors and spellcasters, slaying Taragaman beneath Orgrimmar is a proving ground and helps protect the capital from demonic corruption.
As a warlock, you practice dark arts in the Cleft of Shadow above, while a wild, hostile felguard like Taragaman threatens the secrecy and safety of your craft.
As a warrior, you must stand firm against Taragaman's crushing blows and avoid being tossed into the lava by his brutal uppercuts.
